# runlab-client

> Python client and HTTP spec for the RunLab research API: pre-register an A-vs-B
> comparison, record each seed's metric, and get a verdict. The verdict comes from a paired
> test with a 95 % confidence interval, checked against the plan. It refuses a misleading
> comparison and says which wins a write-up may quote. The client uses only the standard
> library. Get started: `pip install runlab-client`, then `runlab login` (GitHub sign-in);
> `RunLab()` then needs no settings (in CI: env RUNLAB_TOKEN, RUNLAB_URL).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/omer-nachman/runlab-python/blob/main/README.md): get started (`runlab login`, `whoami`, `logout`), quickstart, the loop, verdict codes, studies (also `runlab worker`: seeds on your machine), errors, client reference
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/omer-nachman/runlab-python/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how a coding agent should run the loop and report the result
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://github.com/omer-nachman/runlab-python/blob/main/openapi.json): 11 operations under /api/v1, bearer-token auth

## Examples

- [quickstart.py](https://github.com/omer-nachman/runlab-python/blob/main/examples/quickstart.py): plan, 10 seeds per arm, compare
- [curl.sh](https://github.com/omer-nachman/runlab-python/blob/main/examples/curl.sh): the same loop with curl

## Optional

- [Client source](https://github.com/omer-nachman/runlab-python/blob/main/src/runlab_client/__init__.py): one file, about 700 lines
